status: design specification; NOT a frozen held-out experiment
development: all 37 inspected local Rubric Office videos; existing Cup Games access history must be audited before any split claim
heldout_blocker: independent scene/object-instance inventory and continuous identity/visibility annotations not yet established
freeze_gate: fit thresholds on calibration groups only
hash all configurations before evaluation outcomes
required_fairness: same initialization or separately labelled supervision tracks
same candidate front end for mechanism ablations
do not silently substitute a weak implementation for a named baseline
primary_endpoint: correct accepted identity reacquisition at calibration-selected false-association operating points
operating_point_caveat: report held-out empirical errors and intervals; a calibration target is not a guarantee; report insufficient sample resolution
secondary: delay in frames after first visible return
unresolved_episodes: count as failures in fixed-deadline success; right-censor time-to-event rather than dropping them
intervals: paired cluster bootstrap by independent scene; also raw numerators/denominators; no per-frame independence assumption
hidden_location: evaluate region coverage and area only with independent hidden-location labels; otherwise unmeasured
ablation_rule: report at common measured coverage and common measured false association; confidence thresholds fixed on calibration, not test
active_perception: not claimed until fixed-view, fixed-wait, uncertainty-only and relation-aware policies are run with observation costs
robot_task: not claimed until executed; virtual narration excluded as evidence
scope: real scene occlusion; no post-hoc gray-square benchmark substituted for the target task
